children.hypothesis: Strengthening the pre-final execution gate to require two distinct observed tool results closes reward-zero trials whose agentExecutionMs is null.
Banding final submission behind an iterate-until-checks-pass loop prevents reward-zero trials where the agent finalizes after a single short tool call.
Requiring the agent to run and observe the task's own verifier before submission addresses reward-zero trials returning a wrong artifact.
